claim_as_previously_stated: u is an ACCUMULATOR coordinate: the signal along u grows ~138x with depth.
corrected_claim: Not supported as accumulation. With the axis FROZEN at layer 13 (fit on EASY, held-out EASY prompts), the class gap along it peaks at the start layer and decays with depth in every commissioned arm; separation is maintained only by an axis that is REFIT at each layer (|cos| to u_13 decays). The growth is layer-specific re-writing/rotation, not accumulation along one coordinate. On HARD prompts the EASY-fit layer-13 axis has a NEGATIVE start gap, so a HARD ratio is undefined.
